hints.title: Right-to-Left Replacements
hints.text: Verify matching substrings at specified indices and substitute replacements in right-to-left order.

hints.title: Original Index Preservation
hints.text: Processing replacement operations from highest index to lowest ensures earlier string indices remain unaffected by length changes.

hints.title: Source Match Validation
hints.text: Sort indices in descending order. If the substring of s starting at index matches source, splice target into s replacing source.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Reverse index replacement modifying character array.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Applying substitutions from left to right shifts subsequent indices and produces wrong alignments.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: List of characters requires O(N) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Process replacements in reverse sorted index order or reconstruct string linearly.
